findings.title: Five DHW entities stay enabled-by-default and permanently unavailable with hot water unconfigured
findings.claim: With DHW unconfigured, five of the six _DHWEntityMixin entities are enabled by default and available is False in every refresh, so a user with no hot water is shown five dead entities.
findings.mechanism: sensor._DHWEntityMixin.available gates on coordinator.data['dhw_enabled'], but _attr_entity_registry_enabled_default is True for five of the six classes; only DHWTemperatureSensor sets it False.

perturbation.change: configure DHW on coord_minimal (dhw_tank_volume=200, dhw_setpoint=55, dhw_min_temperature=45)

findings.metric_definition: Enabled-by-default _DHWEntityMixin entities whose available is False after a reference-recipe build of coord_minimal (dhw_enabled == False)

null_control.note: with DHW configured reports 0; every other violation class stays 0 under each non-matching perturbation and moves to 1 under the one it names

findings.proposed_fix_scope: Set _attr_entity_registry_enabled_default = False on the five classes (or on _DHWEntityMixin)
